name: napkin
description: A browser-first, zero-dependency digital café paper napkin for organic sketching and real-time neural handwriting. Draw rough shapes that snap into designer-grade vector ink, drag live hand-sketched boxes and arrows, type directly onto the paper in streaming cursive, choose real top-down pens with velocity-matched paper foley, order a coffee or matcha from the café menu, and crumple finished sheets away with 3D physics.
